title: Are Prediction Markets Accurate?
summary: We evaluated the calibration of Polymarket and Kalshi across 135 million trade positions. Both markets are remarkably accurate: contracts at 50 cents resolve YES exactly 50% of the time. But accuracy varies by category — Sports (Brier Score: 0.1773) lags Finance (0.1500) and Politics (0.1192). The apparent deterioration in Brier Score since 2024 is a measurement artifact: the market is forecasting harder questions, not getting worse at forecasting.
